hook: Levent Alpöge says he and Claude proved
hookText: Levent Alpöge says he and Claude proved

beats.say: Mathematician Levent Alpöge posted a short note claiming that, working with Anthropic's Claude, he found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that extends to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and that the argument has been formalized in Lean.
Instead of a long unreadable paper he is releasing only the Lean development, split into 14 archive parts, and plans a proper human-readable write-up.
Scott Aaronson notes the formalization is about 17.4 million lines of Lean, and that verification by the community is still to come.
